description: CKEditor plugin dialog definition for checkbox element, including UI setup and attribute handling.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.element
classes.description: DOM element wrapper used for attribute manipulation and element creation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new dialog named 'checkbox' with CKEditor.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Retrieves the current selection in the editor.

methods.name: getSelectedElement
methods.description: Gets the currently selected element in the editor.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates a new DOM element within the editor's document.

methods.name: insertElement
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the editor at the cursor position.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Initializes dialog content based on the selected element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Saves dialog data back to the element.
